title: Distant Difficulties
description: Modify local chunk difficulty to scale with distance from 0,0 and lower with time spent in the area
body:
Distant Difficulties serves a simple purpose: A dynamic world boarder created through difficulty increases. To achieve this Distant Difficulties modifies the base game local difficulty logic. In vanilla local difficulty scales with the time spent in the area. Distant Difficulties preserves this but adds to it a distance from 0,0 factor. As you get further from 0,0 the local difficulty exponentially scales. Distant Difficulties also removes the hard cap on local difficulty allowing for difficulty to continue to scale as players move further out. Distant Difficulties influence on local difficulty lessens as players spend time in an area allowing for settlements to be founded in harsh lands and naturally lower the difficulty in the area.

**Features**

- Difficulty increases further from spawn
- Distance based difficulty decreases with time spent in the area

**Planned**

- Configurable scaling
- Multiple distance models

**Things I want to add but have no idea if I can**

- Distance difficulty reverts back to high levels when chunk has been unloaded for long enough
